parsed.title: Discussion on AI-assisted job search and development practices

topics.title: AI tools for job search automation

claims.text: User plans to set up OpenClaw for finding vacancies, generating resumes and cover letters.
Full automation with PDF resume generation is seen as better because humans can analyze the PDF during technical interviews.
Lack of AI skills (Cursor, Claude Code, LLM, RAG, Embeddings) makes job searching for JS/Python positions difficult.

topics.title: Impact of AI on recruitment and developer workflow

claims.text: AI is becoming a market mainstream, and not knowing it hampers job search.
The author expects the recruiter profession to become extinct.
AI-generated code can lead to security and performance issues, such as overly broad SQL queries.
Using GPT to generate joins dramatically speeds up development.
Projects without cloud infrastructure are unlikely to adopt cloud solutions.
Incremental computation has been replaced by view-based approaches.
Poorly reviewed AI-generated code was dropped because it lacked adequacy.
Team members sometimes push SELECT * queries to production without approval.
